text:
alex: FYI, ap-southeast1a is showing a repeatable "pinball" of tiny-gpu pods across racks; evictions spiked and spot churn doubled.
maria: can you paste the pod events? short dump is fine.
alex: heres the events snippet

```
Normal  Scheduled        pod/tiny-trainer-7f5b9   Assigned to rack-az3-node-12
Warning FailedScheduling  pod/tiny-trainer-7f5b9  2/3 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had taint {gpu-preempt=true:PreferNoSchedule}, 1 node(s) had insufficient resources
Normal  Killing         pod/tiny-trainer-7f5b9   Stopping container; kubelet requested kill
```
ben: sounds like rebalancer-induced churn + transient NIC/conntrack pressure. rebalancer drains underutilized racks to defrag and that triggers warmup ripple.
devon: matches metrics we saw last month for the coldstart pinball: eviction -> warmup -> more evicts.
alex: cost hit is ~ $1.4k over 3h in that AZ from extra spot provisioning.
lee: current rebalancer interval is 5m, can we slow it down?
maria: i proposed 20m in a previous rollout but ops reverted it. lease handshake timeouts are 15s today which feels tight.
ben: quick mitigations i suggest:
- set rebalancer.interval = 20m
- set lease.timeout = 60s
- exclude pods labeled tiny-gpu from rebalancer
- apply temporary node-anti-affinity override for tiny workloads
alex: i bumped warmpool earlier (2->5) for the rack, helped a bit but still oscillating.
sre-bot: ALERT: evictions ap-southeast1a > 50 in 30m — paging oncall.
maria: patch i can apply now (configmap snippet below):

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  rebalancer.interval: "20m"
  lease.timeout: "60s"
  rebalancer.exclude-labels: "tiny-gpu"
```
ben: also recommend scheduler scoring change: reduce pack score weight for tiny pods so they don't force aggressive binpack moves.
devon: we should balance cost vs tail-start latency; warmpool increases node cost but reduces churn costs.
lee: temporary manual: add taint `no-rebalance=true:NoSchedule` on rack-az3 nodes while validating.
alex: I'll canary the config in ap-southeast1a and watch evictions for 1h; will share prometheus queries.
maria: i'll own the rollout and monitoring. posting query ids shortly.
ben: longer-term: we need a coalescer that respects network signals (conntrack, tx errors) and avoids moves during network stress.
alex: follow-ups -> @maria (rollout), @ben (scheduler scoring), @devon (cost tail analysis). :thumbsup:
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423 created: eviction-wave ap-southeast1a
